title: Room-creation budget detector
spec: Add src/venue/room-budget.ts: parseRoomBudgetRefusal(status, body): { spentUntilMs } | null, recognising the venue's 429 whose body matches /room-creation budget/i, reading "waiting <n>s" when present, otherwise the next UTC midnight from an injected nowMs. Also isRoomCapError(body) for /room limit reached|room-creation budget/i. Export a RoomBudget class: note(refusal), canCreate(nowMs), and a soft counter of rooms created today with reset at UTC midnight.
done: Recorded 429 bodies map to the right spentUntil, canCreate flips at midnight, and unrelated 429s return null.
